text: Implemented typed kernel/Nyström artifacts: Kernel/KernelSpec, Linear/RBF kernels, LandmarkSet canonicalization, KernelEigenArtifact, NystromFit diagnostics, standard and double Nyström state, and out-of-sample transform semantics. Verified all-landmark linear/RBF exact eigensystems, explicit partial-landmark kernel reconstruction, double Nyström full-rank reconstruction, rank-deficient effective-rank degradation, non-finite kernel errors, and wrong-column transform errors. Verification: sbt "multivarJVM/test" "multivarJS/test" passed 45 tests on each platform; git diff --check -- modules/multivar clean.
